title: Minions & Monsters

title: Enola Holmes 3
overview: Adventure follows detective Enola Holmes to Malta, where her plans to tie the knot unravel when Sherlock's disappearance plunges her into a perilous case.

overview: Freshly divorced, Fanny, a thirty-something from Fécamp, has nothing left of her marriage but a sky-blue sofa, debts she refuses to pay, and an absolute determination never to 'start her life' with a man again. Despite her burning need for freedom, this cleaning lady finds herself stuck back at her parents' house.  That is, until the day she crosses paths with Anemone, a professional mermaid passing through the region. She decides to take the plunge and dive into the world of mermaiding.

title: Polymer
overview: A cuck smokes a cigarette backwards while a failed rapper reminisces on his downfall. They come to realize a startling existential truth.

title: Uprising Smoke

In this confusion, it's necessary to choose a side - or at least be aware of the side chosen. There is no not choosing.

title: EROS

title: Laruan
overview: Ines reenacts her sister's wartime abduction through a game of dolls, only to discover that some games are really just memories wearing a disguise.

title: In Waves

But everything changes when Kristen faces a sudden illness. Together, they face adversity, driven by the strength of their love, their friends, and their newly shared passion for surfing and the ocean.

title: rutina.

The Guests

When Iria’s mother becomes terminally ill, they decide to leave Köln and take her back to Galicia. Their road trip leads them through a variety of social and political systems that existed in the 1970s, while their relationship comes to reflect the zeitgeist.

title: Eagles Become Doves
overview: A party, but its not what he expects.

title: They Took My Daugther
overview: When her daughter goes missing and kidnapped into a world of high-class corruption - a dishonorably discharged mom stops at nothing to find her.

overview: As her mother's Alzheimer's progresses, Maria Rita struggles with the growing weight of becoming her sole caregiver.

title: Colors
overview: Different colors moving into harmony of Children's Corner, L. 113: IV. The snow Is dancing.

When out of financial necessity she rents a room in her apartment to a man who also sneaks-in his nine-year-old son, an unlikely bond forms. Her carefully controlled world begins to shift, and their lives become intertwined against her will.

title: Action
overview: When two actors—Luke and Carlo— meet for their last chemistry read, their relationship is changed by the masks they put on, and the scripts they play out.

title: 23 000 Lives

Inexperienced but driven by passion and courage, they launch a crowdfunding campaign to buy an old ship. Venturing into the Mediterranean, they embark on a mission to save thousands of people. But their efforts soon put their understanding of law and justice to the test.

title: The Bay
overview: Best friends Emma and Lani, attending a destination wedding in Thailand, find themselves trapped on a sinking tour boat in the heart of a tiger shark sanctuary.

title: Nagabandham: The Secret Treasure
overview: A chosen warrior protects a mystical, serpent-bound Himalayan temple from those seeking to steal the power of the Brahma Kamalam, a divine relic.

overview: Nuca, one of the world’s leading bee specialists, celebrates her birthday surrounded by family traditions. As the family matriarch, time is relentless in its toll on her memory loss. In an attempt to remember, she revisits family photographs, and as the past and present intertwine, secrets begin to surface. At this celebration, it won't just be the photos that are revealed.

title: Lockbox
overview: A woman puts her life on the line to protect her troubled, enigmatic cousin, Winthrop, who has been targeted and hunted by a powerful supernatural force.

title: Super Subbu
overview: When Subbu takes a covert job teaching sex ed in rural Makhipur, his life flips upside down; to pursue his dreams, he must educate a resistant village without provoking his traditional father's wrath and balancing his romance.

title: The Trouble With Mistletoe
overview: An acquisitions executive who returns home for Christmas and unexpectedly reconnects with the former fiancé she left behind. As the traditions of her hometown rekindle old memories, she begins to wonder if the life she walked away from may still be the one meant for her.

overview: After failing in the big city, Chen Tao returns home and unexpectedly reunites with his deceased father through an old book, leading to whimsical adventures that heal their rift and inspire him to start anew.

overview: A battle over the Keris Tempa Melaka, a legendary blade linked to warrior Hang Tuah, drawing in a Muay Thai practitioner and a Russian mafia syndicate.

Helena, one of the few people still living outside, is called upon to teach the machine what it cannot comprehend: reality.

title: Rao Bahadur
overview: In 1970s India, an eccentric aristocrat—labeled a 'man of miracles'—miraculously survives a terminal illness. Plagued by guilt and fear, he retreats into his palatial mansion, creating an alternate world that deeply blurs reality and imagination.

title: Petaka Gunung Welirang
overview: Five friends camp on Mount Welirang. On their way to the summit, they encounter a Queen and her royal troops. What mysteries lie hidden within Mount Welirang?

Папа, купи песика

Her joy knows no bounds, but one day, while out for a walk, the girl gets distracted, and the puppy gets lost in the park, left all alone to face the big city. Dippy meets a street cat and a rat named Bangs, and even falls in love with a Chihuahua named Tabby. While Milana searches for her beloved pup, exciting adventures await Dippy—adventures in which he must become a true hero, capable of protecting not only himself but also his friends.

title: Sima's Unfinished Story
overview: Dr Arash Samin, one of the prominent professors in the field of sociology, lives a calm and peaceful life with his doctor wife and young daughter. But the publication of a picture of him in cyberspace puts his personal and family life on a new path..

overview: With unprecedented access to the Brazilian Senate, director Dandara Ferreira follows the entire trajectory of the Covid-19 Parliamentary Inquiry from the inside, transforming this exclusive footage into a cinematic record of one of the most defining moments of the pandemic in Brazil.

title: Cinta Lama Babak Kedua #CLBK
overview: Ambar and Raka have planned their wedding and dreamed of a happy future together, just like any other couple. But their plans are put to the test when Akung Abi and Nin Sita — their grandfather and grandmother — turn out to be former lovers who parted ways 56 years ago. Since their youth, the relationship between Abi and Sita has been shaped by a past filled with stories that were never truly resolved. Without realizing it, that unfinished history begins to affect Ambar and Raka’s relationship in the present. The deeper they uncover their grandparents’ past, the more they feel that something has remained unsettled for the last 56 years.

title: Last Day of Season
overview: On her final day working in a greenhouse, Romanian migrant worker Ana is followed by a documentary crew manipulating her story. Under pressure from her father and boss, tensions escalate. As she realizes she’s losing control, a turning point at work forces her to attempt an escape.

title: Anna, Postmortem
overview: When a young woman is murdered for mysterious reasons, her ghost searches for answers - and revenge.

title: Night of the Living Dead
overview: A ragtag group barricade themselves in an old Pennsylvania farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls ravaging the Northeast.

title: Simpsley
overview: When penniless con-artist Marge Bouvier is sent to Italy to convince wealthy sap Seymour Skinner to come home, she’s tempted by the trappings of his affluent lifestyle. But there’s a big fat fly in the ointment: Skinner’s clingy, dim-witted mooch of a houseguest, Homer Simpsley. Lies, lust and Italian lira are abound.

title: Keep Real
overview: Thirty years ago, the Super Ying Association led by Superman Wang Changhai crushed the aliens. Years later, Wang Changhai was appointed to return to his hometown to set up a combat squad, but in the town of Rheinland, which had been peaceful for many years, human feelings and courtesies have left Wang Changhai overwhelmed, creating layers of obstacles to Wang's ability to complete his mission.

title: Satluj
overview: Triggered by the search for his missing aunt, human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra takes on a broken system in a courageous fight to uncover the conspiracy behind thousands of disappearances and extrajudicial killings during the nadir of Punjab’s period of insurgency.

title: Wings of Dread
overview: Air police officer Gu Chaoyang encounters a hijacking crisis on his flight back to China. With his extremely high professional ethics, he fights desperately to stop the hijacker, and a life-and-death struggle that takes place at an altitude of ten thousand meters begins.

title: Man of War
overview: When an aid worker vanishes in the first hours of war in Ukraine, a former Navy SEAL and CIA operative crosses into the shattered country to bring her home-facing mercenaries, shifting battle lines, and ghosts he thought he left behind.

title: Helena
overview: Helena, the only hilot in a small town who secretly has affairs with her patients' husbands. After a pregnant patient dies upon discovering Helena's affair with her own husband, the enraged townsfolk turn against her.

title: The Odyssey
overview: Based on the Ancient Greek epic. After ten years of war, King Odysseus sets sail for Ithaca, eager to reunite with his beloved. But his journey home is far more treacherous than the battlefield, as he must face deadly monsters and vengeful gods to survive.

title: Graamaayana
overview: In a rustic village, young Seena earns his "Sixth Sense" nickname through remarkable intuition. His journey through community conflicts, romantic entanglements, and family bonds reveals the essence of rural existence.

title: Gatta Kusthi 2
overview: Picks up after the first film, with Veera and Keerthi balancing parenthood and Keerthi's wrestling career, featuring a role reversal where Veera takes on more domestic responsibilities.

title: Tropical SOV: Bizarre Sci-fi Samba
overview: Once again, 23 Brazilian filmmakers come together for the second Tropical SOV anthology, now exploring sci-fi in humorous stories involving aliens and their space invasions, mad scientists, time travel, dystopias, and a myriad of end-of-the-world scenarios.

title: Summer's Last Resort
overview: Determined to save her mom from another bad relationship, a teen accidentally turns a luxury vacation into total chaos.

title: Nevermind
overview: In the neon-lit streets of Kolkata, a woman searching for redemption crosses paths with a mysterious bar singer whose past remains hidden. Over the course of a restless day, their lives intertwine with strangers carrying their own conflicts and secrets, until a buried truth changes everything.

title: Gurthukosthunnayi
overview: Follows Santosh, a young man who forgets his past including his school days and love Vaishali, as his friends and family help him retrieve his memory by walking him through his early life experiences.

title: Wish You Were Dead
overview: On a night when thunder and lightning strike, the deceased grandfather returns home as a zombie. Eighteen-year-old granddaughter Seohyun leads her family to launch an operation to kill the grandfather who became a zombie.

title: JE VEUX FAIRE UN FILM ABSTRAIT !
overview: Émile, a cinema student at Janot High School, must make a short-film for his film studies diploma. To carry out his project, he needs to form a group with some of his classmates, with whom he will be confronted, given the rather strange nature of his project...

title: La belle histoire de la chanson française
Sidekicks
overview: Two best friends debate what should be done with their newly acquired superpowers.

title: object and object
overview: Chung-jae, a repairman, cannot stop turning "a round golden doorknob" in a client's bedroom. He visits a consulting room to find its cause.  Da-gam, an actor, visits his friend Doo-joon to borrow "a funeral suit" when someone dies. "So who died this time?" Doo-joon asks over a beer. "An actress I worked with."  Two men, each in an empty seat, begin to tell their story — about object and object.

title: Le Temps d'une Tartine 2
overview: While Mixel tries the best he can to help along with Martin's parents, Charlène and Martin have escaped the flames and appeared somewhen else, where twists and turns won't end. Why is everything happening? To find that out... they must go Back to the Toaster!

title: The Gang
overview: Ayman, a teenager of Moroccan descent, is invited by Sara to a party at the same house where his mother works as a domestic worker. Along with Eric and Robert, his lifelong friends, they set off on a journey filled with confrontations and disappointments -with society and with themselves- putting their gang's friendship to the test. Once at the party, they discover that life isn't what they thought, and that wanting something doesn't always make it possible.

title: Action Stage: Helios Rising Heroes -New Dawn-
overview: Four years have passed since the "Lost Zero" incident.  Keith Max still believes in the survival of Dino Albani, who was presumed dead, and continues to pursue him.  Meanwhile, Brad Beams keeps a close eye on Keith's precarious actions, striving to find answers to his own doubts.  At this time, a new "Eclipse" threat creeps into the city.  In the midst of this chaotic situation, standing before the "Heroes" is "Zero," with whom they have fought countless times.  As they confront each other once again, the lost time begins to move violently once more.

title: Imprevisible, inevitable: un trajecte del metro a la Dana de València
Find Me
overview: During the COVID-19 lockdown, a series of mysterious murders spreads fear across the city. As the investigation unfolds, hidden secrets and unexpected twists make it increasingly difficult to identify the killer. Every clue leads to another mystery in this Tamil crime thriller.

title: Hangman
overview: Sivayya, an executioner, sees a girl resembling his late daughter. She rebuffs his stares. They're both subjected to assault. Enraged, Sivayya turns vigilante, accompanied by his son, seeking justice beyond his official role.

title: THE ORIGIN OF ULTRAMAN
overview: The landmark Japanese Tokusatsu TV series Ultraman became a massive social phenomenon upon its debut in 1966, reaching a staggering peak viewership rating of 42.8%. Six decades later, Tsuburaya Productions continues to introduce new entries into the Ultraman series, expanding its unique universe to a global audience across generations. This documentary brings together leading voices from the fields of cinema, Tokusatsu, and design. Witness profound testimonies from an international assembly of creators, including: Guillermo del Toro, Hirokazu Kore-eda, Hideo Kojima, Hideaki Anno, Shinji Higuchi, and Nicolas Winding Refn.

title: Ask Me Anything
overview: One question. Seven worlds. In an unidentified space, among participants suspicious of one another, a woman wearing the number tag "4235" steps into an interview chamber. Waiting for her are an unsettling interviewer and a mysterious black spherical device. With the question, "What are you most afraid of?", she is thrown into worlds of deep oceans, collapsing airplanes, ruined cities, frozen wastelands, and hell-like realms, where she confronts buried memories, guilt, and the darkest corners of human nature. As participants begin disappearing one by one, she realizes that the interview is not a simple test, but a massive experiment designed to examine the boundaries of human nature and existence itself.

title: 9 Moons
overview: Ángel is a personal trainer who, after taking a year off, has just landed a job at the most prestigious gym in the city, and life finally seems to be back on track. But everything changes when he begins to feel unwell, goes to the hospital, and receives shocking news: he’s pregnant. A trans man on the verge of completing his transition, Ángel is now confronted with a life-altering decision—one that will challenge his identity, his aspirations, and his very understanding of masculinity.

title: The Nation
overview: A First Nation Chief develops radical ideas about sovereignty.

title: The Mage
overview: A series of deaths suddenly occurs in the city. Police officer Wong Ming realizes that at the scene of each death, there is the figure of a woman who collects garbage. In the course of investigation, Wong discovers that this woman, Lan Pui Ching (played by Josie HO), has the mysterious ability to collect the souls of the accidental deaths from the garbage and help these souls to enter the reincarnation. This all started with a story that happened to her 13 years ago. Meanwhile, the murders continue to happen. Lan Pui Ching deduces that these murders are related to a mysterious cult ritual, and she and Wong Ming will be the next victims of this ritual. Wong Ming decides to cooperate with Lan Pui Ching to find out the mastermind behind the scene.

title: Mary Oliver: Saved by the Beauty of the World
overview: From a lonely childhood to literary fame, her life was shaped by devotion to nature, paying attention, and the long journey toward learning to love and to be loved.  If poetry had a pop icon, Mary Oliver would be it.

title: Dear Sis Dolly
overview: An ambitious and intellectual psychologist finds herself having to dismantle her identity when she lands a job as an agony aunt for famed Drum Magazine and learns that being 'real' is as important as being 'clever'.

title: Granny
overview: Rony, a home nurse movies into a remote house to take care of a strange old woman only know an 'Granny'. His sanity starts slipping as her behavior turns increasingly eccentric.

title: Double Barrel
overview: A thirst for power pulls Surya into a deadly rivalry. But once the violence begins, is there any way back?

title: Le miracle
overview: After Angelica is disturbed by her adult son Mattia in her relaxation bath, she is finally able to let go. She begins to masturbate in front of the poster of footballer Valenti, her son's idol. Suddenly, Valenti's gaze fixes on her… a cry for help. An absurd euphoria spreads: the miracle crystallises into a struggle for power and intimacy between mother and son.

title: Brón
overview: Nineteen-year-old Sersha Cleary is struggling with adulthood and mental illness when she experiences a harrowing coincidence. Three knocks and a bone-chilling scream hours before her grandmother passes. The signature of a banshee an Irish myth her grandmother told her stories about when she was little. After her grandmother passes Sersha finds herself alone and struck with intense grief, fighting with her family and struggling with her everyday life. Amongst her struggles she finds herself haunted by a banshee unable to escape its grasps.

title: Czech Girl
overview: Widowed Zdena lives a quiet life as a postwoman in a small Czech village. When her beloved son Lukas returns home from France to say goodbye to his dying grandmother, his determination to make her seemingly impossible wish come true leads him to reveal a secret that challenges the values of the village: his queer life in Paris and his drag queen alter ego, Chica Checa.

A group of five, a chain of bizzare events, layers of schemes and plot twists. It's all-you-can-experience in One Crazy Night!

overview: After being Kidnapped from his home, Phoenix finds he is the chosen one, who will be sacrificed to the Sun.

Over the course of a week, their content changed and then they suddenly vanished. This is the footage recovered from their social media, computers, and SD cards. Experts believe the footage shows the worldwide phenomenon known as Alikabiha, also called the Waiting Man.

overview: In the troubled night of Seoul on the verge of apocalypse, Niko, a penniless scriptwriter, works a part-time job as a companion for people who have lost their keys. When she can no longer satisfy her longing for true love in this once melancholic, sensual, and bustling city, she disappears. Her boyfriend Jeremy and their new friend Ji-eun start looking for the missing Niko and become entangled in a love triangle. At last, Niko finds a new, reckless, and ultimate way to express her feelings.

overview: A famous writer nearing retirement discovers that he possesses the ability to "rewrite the past", however everything has their own consequences.

overview: After buying a pair of shoes that end up hurting her feet, Nami returns to the shop feeling dissatisfied. There, she meets Lebno, the designer, who tells her, "I'll make you a brand-new pair from scratch—but only if you’ll be my model." The shoes are crafted by the artisan Miucha, leading to an unexpected and stylish encounter.

title: Legend of Qingqiu
overview: Luo Rong'er, an illusion created by the Nine-Tailed Master, begins to question her purpose after meeting the righteous constable Mo Chen. As their bond grows, she must choose between obeying her creator and protecting the man she loves.

title: Hammerhead Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
overview: In Mexico’s Pacific waters, Bertie Gregory goes in search of one of the ocean’s most iconic predators: the hammerhead shark. Once abundant in these seas, hammerhead numbers have plummeted, making sightings increasingly rare. Bertie investigates what’s driving the hammerhead decline, and how protected waters offer hope for the future. His journey culminates in a rare and unforgettable encounter that shines a light on the future of one of the world’s most famous sharks.

title: RAYE live at Montreux Jazz Festival
overview: Marking the opening of the 60th edition of the Montreux Jazz Festival, RAYE invites a host of international pop stars to join her on stage for an evening of music.

overview: What started as a student exercise and master’s degree project soon evolved into a creative partnership and personal friendship between Jana Hojdová, a former cinematography student at Prague’s FAMU, and distinguished cinematographer Robert Richardson.

title: ORDINARY BOX
overview: An ordinary box can be surprising.

title: Crossroads
overview: A man attempts to cross the street before his time.

title: Half-Dead, Half-Dead Can't Get Out. Odyssey 1992
overview: Two directors begin casting a film about the 1990s, which gradually devolves into a space of uncertainty where the distinction between document and fiction disappears. This subtle disruption in the process—the appearance of a single actor obsessed with "accuracy"—leads to a loss of control and implicates them. At the edge of this experience, between life and death, both directors find themselves inside their own, never-made film.

overview: Actor Lee Yong fails even his thousandth audition. Just as he is about to give up on everything, a flyer catches his eye: "7 Days Until Submission Deadline for the Bucheon International Fantastic Film Festival." He seeks out Chang-kyung, a former film director living in seclusion after a devastating failure, and proposes a reckless plan — to make a film in just seven days. With no budget, no crew, and no future, wounded souls begin gathering one by one. Soon, the bizarre filming of a period fantasy begins: a woodcutter turned into a bloodthirsty monster and a fairy transformed into a ghost bride.

title: The Lion at My Back
overview: Mariama, an asylum-seeker from Senegal, has just turned 18. Stella, at first glance a withdrawn woman in her 40s, has recently decided to break free from the clutches of addiction and to give her life a fresh start. In their attempt at finding their place in a world where nothing comes for free, the two women meet and form an unexpectedly strong bond.

title: O Motorista da meia-noite: o Retorno
Farm House
overview: House sitting can be relaxing, peaceful and refreshing, but terror is here to stay. This Warren County Serial Killings Cases is just one of the most perplexing and tragic chapters in the recent American criminal history.

overview: When a crew of criminals attempts to steal cursed Confederate gold from a haunted Louisiana plantation, they discover that the voodoo protecting the treasure is terrifyingly real… and the dolls are awake.

title: Cashcade
overview: A burglar on the run accidentally leaves a trail of cash that leads a homeless man into an unexpected discovery.

title: Marave
overview: It follows Manolo, a gentle, naive fairground worker. When their father gets sick, Manolo reunites with his older brother Georges, a con man who abandoned the family twenty years ago. Desperate to prove he is not a failure, Georges schemes to turn the physically strong Manolo into an MMA (Mixed Martial Arts) champion.

title: Summer Sparks
overview: Follows a single father and a single mom at Camp Evergreen during a summer cook-off, where cooking mishaps and heartfelt moments lead to an unexpected romantic connection.

title: Control
overview: A notorious kidnapper has struck again. While a girl was on her way home from school, the kidnapper managed to abduct her. Detective Lucas Fonck is investigating the case and is gathering information from various residents in the neighborhood where the girl lives.  His first interview takes place at the home of a man named Wout de Jonge, and during the interview, both men begin to realize that there is more to the other than meets the eye.

title: NJPW Tiger Mask's Retirement Match
overview: The event was hosted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) for Tiger Mask's official retirement match, ending his 36-year career on July 7, 2026 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

overview: After waking up on her father's isolated forest property with amnesia, Vivian must use her limited memory to piece together the nightmarish truth, all the while being tormented by the undead, a giant leech monster, and her "father."

title: Aracne
overview: Eris is a talented and ambitious young chef who works at the prestigious Medusa restaurant. The restaurant is run by Palas, an experienced chef whose work style clashes with that of our protagonist. Eris enters a culinary duel for Palas’s position, and that’s when a dead spider is discovered on her plate. Eventually, the two open up to each other and reveal their vulnerabilities as they reflect on the price of pursuing their dreams.

title: Paris Paris
overview: Three men—from China, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Palestine—live together in a squatted apartment in a seemingly abandoned building in Paris. The group is bound together by their shared experience of life in exile and the fleeting nature of their possessions, relationships, and sense of home, but the temporary safe space is threatened by outside forces and events.

title: Knives
overview: A juxtaposition of knives, scissors, weapons, and bombs in photographic format while showing women victims of Iranian attacks in Palestine.

title: Что ты здесь видишь
overview: Upon meeting Masha, Sanya felt something other than anger and apathy for the first time in a long time. But his attempt to keep her turned into an outburst of the very aggression he was trying to escape. Now he must face the consequences, realizing that he had destroyed the most precious thing he had with his own hands.

title: Yayo
overview: Dana and Lydia are facing a serious trust issue in their relationship. After an argument that threatens to tear them apart, Lydia decides to accompany Dana to her grandfather’s house, where his wife has just passed away. There, the elderly man, driven by despair, becomes possessed by a demonic force and begins to hunt them down. Together, they must resolve their differences and learn to trust one another in order to survive.

title: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You
overview: Jeff Arcuri's rapid-fire wit is nonstop as he balances outrageous jokes with heartfelt reflections on making his wife laugh during her cancer journey.

title: Our House
overview: Three estranged siblings reunite at the family home for their late mother’s wake, prompting an inheritance battle that turns deadly.

title: Backrooms Bigfoot
overview: Two strangers wake up, trapped in the endless backrooms and are hunted by a massive supernatural Bigfoot creature lurking in the maze. As reality breaks around them, they must fight to survive and find a way out before it kills them.

title: Learning to Breathe Under Water
overview: Leo is 8. His best friend is a giant shark that his dad, an artist, built in their roof. Leo escapes to fantasy worlds to process his peculiar reality until a spirited au pair challenges him to embrace the wild, wonderful mess of real life.

title: Трудные папы
overview: Katya is smart, modest and diligent, but most importantly, she is very convenient for those around her, which they take advantage of. After the death of her overprotective mother, Katya inherits her mother's late lover Andrey Nikolaevich, who has nowhere else to live, along with the house. However, this is not our heroine's main problem. The secrets that her mother hid from Katya during her life, the mortgage debt, because of which she could lose her home, and the mysterious man to whom her mother has been sending large sums of money for many years - Katya will have to figure all this out, and for the first time in her life - on her own.

title: Genuïns, això és una altra lliga
Nothing to Lose
overview: She gave everything to become a mother, so when her young son falls ill, Jada will stop at  nothing to find a donor and save him — no matter the cost.

title: Blog
overview: Fedya is a failed business psychologist. During one of his training sessions, while intoxicated, he makes a scene and becomes a laughing stock in the eyes of those around him. In his blog, Fedya broadcasts the "secrets of success," but he himself has long lost control of his life. His daughter Sonya is a withdrawn, problematic teenager. After her mother's death, an insurmountable wall grew between her and her father, and her grandfather took upon himself the girl's upbringing. After a fight with her peers, Sonya risks ending up in a penal colony - to avoid punishment, she is sent to a summer correctional program at a provincial school. Fedya goes with his daughter: to look after her and at the same time work as a school psychologist until the information noise around his name dies down. There is one summer ahead that can change everything.

title: Le meilleur du festival We Love Green
Pacific
overview: A group of young travelers are stranded on an island in the Pacific where they struggle to escape an evil presence kept hidden from mankind for centuries.

title: Hana Korea
overview: A young North Korean refugee fights to rebuild her life in fast-paced, hyper-modern South Korea, forcing her to confront the price of freedom and the past she left behind.

title: La chaleur
overview: It’s unusually hot on the beaches of the Landes, and 17-year-old Marouane is spending his last day at the campground with a nagging fear: will the body he buried on the beach the day before be discovered? Marouane also wonders if he might be falling in love with the charming Giulia.

title: Mirage
overview: Mirages have been reported along the Spanish coast. A young French woman travels to San Sebastián to observe these visual aberrations. There, she meets a mysterious Portuguese woman who tells her a story from her youth: of obsession, and a gaze that can turn the world inside out.

title: Lino D’Italia - Storia di un itALIENO
Giorgio Moroder & Donna Summer : I Feel Love
overview: A look back at the meeting in Munich in 1977 between composer and producer Giorgio Moroder and singer Donna Summer, which was to result, amongst other global hits, in the extraordinary “I Feel Love”.

title: Hijamat
overview: Fifty-year-old Murad’s life is shaken to the core when he learns that his younger brother is gay. Murad would like to support his brother, but their traditional Muslim family is against it. As a result, he finds himself subjected to pressures from all sides – from his father, who has close ties to the local imam, and from his brother’s circle of friends as well. He would like to help everyone, but as he slowly falls into a spiral of conflicts and mounting difficulties, he finds that he, too, is in need of help. Another integral part of this family drama is the theme of migration and dialogue – not just between different religions, but within communities themselves.

title: Cat's Blood (Proof of Concept)
overview: Through the eyes of William Maves, the personal driver of Nico Marchesi, we follow a deadly clash between two rival families in South Africa, where blackmail, betrayal, and revenge turn love, loyalty, and blood into weapons—and one misstep can be fatal.

title: Street of Dreams
overview: After her life is disrupted, Calle is seen holding on to soccer as a source of purpose and possibility. As she navigates uncertainty and self-doubt, she is guided by Sir David Beckham who appears as a personification of her inner voice, a guardian only she can see. He’s a powerful symbol of belief and opportunity, standing with her and showing up when it matters.

title: Infiltrate
overview: In a city overrun by crime, government Agent Lily Chen is forced to choose between her duty and her family when her husband is kidnapped, and she’s blackmailed into assassinating high-level criminals to save him. As she delves deeper into the criminal underworld, Lily’s relentless pursuit of justice unravels a web of corruption, leading to a final, life-altering decision that will change her world forever.

title: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
overview: Small-town Kansas hairdresser Gail Daughtry's fiancé uses his 'celebrity sex pass' on Jennifer Aniston, prompting Gail to travel to LA with her friend Otto to find her own pass, Jon Hamm, to even the score.

title: Murder Game
overview: Three years ago, assassin Tide betrayed her organization by refusing to carry out a kill order. After escaping death, she adopted the alias Minghui and lived in seclusion in a small town with her blind sister Mingzhu, running a coffee shop. An accident exposes their whereabouts, and former accomplices track them down, catching Mingzhu in a manhunt. To save her sister, Chao Xi is forced to return to the killing game, and her hidden identity is revealed amidst the gunfire.

title: I, Nobody
overview: Rajeevan, an ordinary government employee, witnesses something he was never meant to see and is thrust into the centre of a serious crime. Branded a troublemaker and hunted by the system, he must protect his family while fighting to survive against forces far beyond his control.

title: Mukhbir: The Story of a Spy - The Movie
overview: An Indian spy embarks on a perilous mission in Pakistan to save India. Will he succeed?

title: Трасса «Море — море»
overview: A red convertible is speeding from St. Petersburg to Sochi, driven by the brazen photographer Tyoma. With him are his ex-wife, Sasha, and her new fiancé. Tyoma will do anything to prevent Sasha's new wedding. And the fatal hitchhiker Kira, rescued by the guys, will help him. Tyoma has only one way across the country to change and win back the love of his life-if his brakes don't fail.

title: Korean Haunted Hospital
overview: A group of Indonesians: Juna, Adit, Bara, Arum, Yuri, and Tyas set out to live-stream a test of courage at the so-called most haunted hospital in South Korea, Yong-Won Hospital. Rumor has it that the hospital was once a front for a cult whose members chose to die following their leader. Now, the hospital is in a state of disrepair and no one dares to enter. This motivates Juna and his friends to become the first people to live-stream there.

title: Election Day
overview: On the election night that will decide her political fate, MP Renata Innocenti sees her career teetering on the brink of ruin when her partner becomes the center of a massive media scandal. Amidst family tensions and political chaos, Renata must fight to save everything she has built.

title: Foufo
overview: The encounter of Madurese residents with small aliens that triggers hilarious chaos and unexpected adventures.

title: Bad Luck
overview: A suicidal taxi driver must confront his own mortality when he finds himself complicit in the attempted murder of a diabetic cat

title: Mama
overview: After many years working far from home, Mila is forced to temporarily leave her seaside mansion—and her secret romance—to return to her family in a remote Polish village. But the long-awaited reunion is far from what she imagined.  As tensions surface, Mila struggles to repair what was lost, confronting the cost of her choices and the woman she has become.

title: Note From a Gutter Boy
overview: After a young man is murdered in a violent street brawl in Melbourne's western suburbs, his best friend Tommy recounts the circumstances that led to his demise during a court-ordered group therapy session.

title: Дети наши
overview: Every year, approximately 48,000 children end up in orphanages. Some find families, others remain in the orphanage until they reach adulthood, and only then set out on their own. But how can you become independent in the adult world without an adult? How do you manage your daily life if you don't know one? How do you find work and save money? And what about finding friends and love? Psychologists, foundation leaders, and the children themselves will discuss the subtle difficulties, stereotypes, and adaptation outside of orphanages. This film is an inside look at the problem of orphanhood in Russia—the perspective of people who are tackling it right now.

title: Hungry
overview: A high school wrestling coach must overcome addictive behavior in ordere to lead his team to a championship.

title: Nocaretown
overview: In the surreal town of Nocaretown, a group of bizarre characters become entangled in a dangerous, absurd quest centered on a mysterious wooden box.

title: Qadira
overview: Sukant returns from a work trip and finds out that his partner, Tara, has ended their relationship and left. The heartbreak, combined with his failing startup, builds up to a point where he tries to end his life. But then he receives an unexpected phone call.

title: The Invite
overview: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places.

title: Moana
overview: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

title: Evil Dead Burn
overview: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.

title: Siping
overview: A gripping story about a woman wagered in a high-stakes card game. But the stakes get even hotter when she’s won by the man who’s long been obsessed with her.

title: Ikka
overview: With a loved one's life at stake, a celebrated lawyer must defend a man he suspects is guilty — battling his conscience every step of the way.

title: Idhayam Murali
overview: A young man navigates the complexities of unrequited love, finding that even as years pass and life takes unexpected turns, certain emotions remain deeply embedded in his heart.

title: Dhamaal 4
overview: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

title: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
overview: Never-before-seen footage and survivor accounts trace the 2012 shipwreck of a luxury cruise and the disaster that ensued, in this immersive documentary.

title: The Outer Threat
overview: After making a groundbreaking extraterrestrial discovery, astrophysicists Daniel and Michelle are forced to flee from home with their family — pursued through the countryside by a relentless and anonymous assailant. As their flight unfolds, the line between cosmic revelation and human paranoia blurs, leading to a tense and emotional confrontation that challenges the boundaries of understanding, science, and survival.

title: Miguel Ángel Blanco: The 48 Hours That Changed Spain
overview: This documentary explores how Miguel Ángel Blanco's 1997 abduction turned fear into collective resistance and shaped Spain's fright Against ETA terrorism.

title: Lenin
overview: Young, urban-raised Lenin's peaceful romance with Bharathi inadvertently sparks a violent, large-scale village conflict.

title: Sunset Strip Killers
overview: Based on a true story, in 1980s Los Angeles, nurse Carol Bundy falls for the charming but deadly Doug Clark. Drawn into his world of murder, obsession, and blood, she becomes complicit in shocking crimes across the city.

title: All Wishes Come True!
overview: Eight grassroot mortals use their street smarts and hilarious schemes to defy powerful gods, earning their title as the "Eight Immortals."

title: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table - 44: CLOUDY BEACH
Running Man Vietnam 2026: The Lord Of Time
overview: Humanity races endlessly, dreaming of becoming the Lord of Time—believing that only by mastering time can they find true freedom in a relentless world. Yet even the divine beasts who govern the flow of time are trapped by the very power they possess, as their greatest gift has become an inescapable burden. Now, a breathtaking battle of supernatural abilities is about to unfold. But does the crown of the Lord of Time truly exist?

title: The One Next Door
overview: When a mysterious stranger moves in next door to Robert and Tabitha, boundaries are tested, loyalty is questioned, and danger comes for all.

title: Hong Kong Crime Story
overview: Four interconnected stories reveal the crime, corruption, and everyday struggles hidden beneath the glamorous surface of 1990s Hong Kong.

title: Barrio Triste
overview: On the outskirts of Medellín, Colombia in the late 1980s, local residents report strange lights descending from the sky. When a reporter arrives to investigate, a ragtag group of teens from a lawless neighbourhood storm the scene and steal his camera. In the hands of its new owners, the device records a mesmerising plunge into their frantic existence.

title: Night Nurse
overview: As a series of perverse scam calls unsettles an idyllic retirement community, a starry-eyed nurse becomes entangled with her mysterious patient.

title: Aajo Ardhangini
overview: Set against the backdrop of an unexpected wedding invitation, a chance reunion after two years of estrangement forces two women to confront their deeply entangled, hidden past. As their unresolved history resurfaces in the shadows of the Chatterjee household, an unsuspecting husband finds himself increasingly caught in a web of unspoken anxieties.

title: Mockbuster
overview: A struggling filmmaker’s opportunity collides with chaos and compromise when Sharknado’s notorious studio, The Asylum, invites him to direct a "mockbuster."

title: Sarpanch
overview: For the last two decades, in the rural heartlands of Punjab, the elected leadership of a small village has done nothing to develop the community, instead engaging in corrupt and harmful practices. To save his home and combat pressing issues, Fateh steps up to take charge and run for the position of Sarpanch (village head), which forces him to confront intense opposition.

title: Bhagdaud
overview: The relentless rat race of life, exploring the struggles and ambitions of individuals navigating the complexities of their modern existence.

title: The Night Everything Changed
overview: When Tina's teenage daughter doesn't return home from a sleepover with her closest friends, she goes on a frantic hunt to find her before it's too late. In the process, she unravels dark secrets of a forbidden romance and a tryst among BFFs.

title: Haciendo amigos
overview: Antonio and Félix, small-time thieves fleeing police after a jewelry heist, meet Eva, a theater group monitor. She mistakes Félix for Ángel, a new member. They use the confusion to hide, unaware they'll spend a week with the group.

title: Flowery Voices
overview: After a fight, a young man calls up a friend.

title: Love on a Tightrope
overview: In 1960s Spain, legendary trapecist Pinito del Oro hires young poet Natalia Sosa Ayala to help with her memoirs, sparking a profound emotional bond between them. Through historical events, intimate encounters, and decades of letters, their admiration, affection, and creative passion intertwine. The story moves between memory, desire, and imagination, showing how these two artists influence each other’s quests for freedom, artistic expression, and recognition. Rooted in real moments but told with a dreamlike, imaginative lens, it explores what might have been between them, revealing a tender, evocative tale of connection, longing, and the courage to defy societal constraints.

title: Mala
overview: Reema inherits an abandoned resort on a remote island, and with her three friends, sets out to uncover the truth behind her inheritance. She soon discovers strange locals, cryptic messages from her late mother, and a familial curse involving tantric rituals and black magic. As tensions rise, Reema and her friends must confront their deepest fears to survive the island’s sinister grip.

title: Still Water
overview: In 2008, as China basks in Olympic glory, Xi, a domestic worker, remains haunted by the loss of her sister in a devastating earthquake. When she learns of her sister’s reincarnation, she becomes drawn to her employer’s unborn child, convinced it is her sister.

title: Cinco días con Lara
overview: Lara Martorell is a transgender actress working to make a name for herself in the acting world. On a trip to Asturias, where she lives, we’ll take a look at her present and her past to understand the long journey that has led her to become the Lara she is today.

title: The Floaters
overview: Struggling musician Nomi accepts a last-resort job from her overachiever best friend Mara: mentoring misfit campers, the “Floaters,” at their childhood Jewish summer camp. As the camp struggles to survive amidst competition with a longtime rival, Nomi, the Floaters, and Mara must overcome their differences to bring the community together and save the camp.

title: The Isolate Thief
overview: A young woman struggles to conceal the gold she stole from a group of violent outlaws who have seized control of her remote outpost.

title: Rakky
overview: Rakky (2026), Action Crime Thriller released in Kannada language

title: Down the Long River
overview: In the aftermath of the Civil War, a former Army surgeon, a notorious gang, and a duplicitous Pinkerton agent cross paths in a tiny river town. When revenge and a fortune in gold are at stake, the town is caught in the crossfire.

title: Kung Fu Soccer
overview: The "Supreme Invincible Cup" is about to begin, and a host of top teams are about to engage in an unprecedented showdown! But the Kung Fu Women's Soccer Team has been dealt a hellish script right from the start?! Their opponents are all highly skilled, and external pressure is mounting. The schemes on the field are one after another... Can they use their kung fu to turn the tide on the green field?

title: Me Before Me
overview: A young student battling pressure, panic and a demanding father uses a class project to discover that truth — not trophies — might finally set him free.

title: O Little Christmas Market
overview: An artist's fights to saves her town's beloved Christmas market from a developer but a budding romance with the architect tied to the deal may help bring about a Christmas miracle.

title: Aether
overview: A grieving man is taken on an journey through strange worlds by a hooded figure in the hope of recovering his dead wife.

title: Dongamohan
overview: Mohan is a thief attempting to steal from a wealthy household. Will he get caught or get away?

title: Speaking Dead
overview: When a massive terror threat paralyzes downtown Seoul, former forensic scientist Jang Jae-wook arrives trailing a mysterious suitcase—containing a dead body instead of explosives. The dark shadow of a decade-old military incident comes to light, revealing a massive web of corruption spun by a deeply entrenched cartel of power. As the dead begin to speak, the buried truth is finally dragged into the light.

title: Deconstructing Guilherme
overview: A brief yet exciting journey through the most memorable moments in the life of Guilherme Gomes - creator of  "A Psique de Guilherme" - during the celebrations of its 4th anniversary.

title: Left ın the Dark
overview: On a dark night, Uncle Sabi, an elderly motorcyclist, offers a ride to a young woman he encounters by chance. When she disappears at the end of the journey, leaving behind an abandoned baby, the situation blurs the boundaries between compassion and responsibility. And leads to an unexpected confrontation.

title: J.
overview: David keeps seeing his ex in other people's faces.

title: I Can't Say No to Myself
overview: Zohar, a young dancer, arrives in Berlin to visit her best friend Shira. She meets Gillen, an insecure German poet, and together with Shira’s boyfriend, the four form a friendship that, for a moment, makes anything seem possible. But as the bond between Zohar and Gillen deepens, the bubble they have built around themselves begins to unravel. When a violent incident reveals sides of each other, they had never seen before, the two refuse to let go. What begins as an attempt to repair their relationship, culminates in an intimate and extreme event that will change them both. An intimate portrait of young people searching for belonging and meaning in the world, struggling with the gap between fantasy and reality.

title: Chunks
overview: An anthology film of six unique comedy shorts threaded together with your host, faded Hollywood starlet Ruby, and taking inspiration from the glamourous by-gone era of late nite public access weirdness.  With live action shorts featuring originals from Podcast About List, Sandy Honig, Nate Fisher & Will Senett, and two animated segments from Episode 1 & Jim Soper, and Nick Mullen & Saul Crinier.

title: THE MIND
overview: Shine, a 20-year-old, frequently experienced violence within her family, leaving her unable to escape the shadow of that past.

title: Still Ohio
overview: Desperate to salvage her relationship, a college student embarks on a cross-country carpool only to find herself trapped in a haunting time loop where each stop at a lonely Ohio gas station grows more terrifying than the last.

title: Bótharín
overview: With his beloved older sister in the throws of Alzheimer's and on her deathbed, an elderly man pieces together an uncertain truth which tosses their whole relationship into question.

title: Glass Saints
overview: A group of young men ranging from the ages of 18 to 24 live their bizarre eccentric lives in a world that doesn't understand them. They navigate life's course one day at a time.

title: Between Us
overview: Marina and David, two young artists, no longer feel the same passion that they've had for one another upon the early stages of their relationship. As time goes on, tensions grow and it all reaches a powerful breaking point.

title: Let Sleeping Cats Lie
overview: Unlike a cat you only get one life so sometimes it's better to let sleeping cats lie.

title: Oru Vadakkan Velicham - A Northern Light
overview: When a young man is taken in for questioning about the disappearance of a woman, a seemingly routine interrogation slowly unravels into something far more personal. As hidden relationships, buried secrets, and long-suppressed truths begin to surface, the lines between justice, guilt, and revenge become increasingly blurred. Set against the backdrop of Canada, Oru Vadakkan Velicham is a Malayalam investigative thriller that explores deception, trauma, and the consequences of the past.

title: Plötzlich Schwester
overview: Two sisters who couldn't be more different are unaware of their father's double life with two families and the existence of the other until his sudden death. While stuffy Sandra has no need for such a relationship, chaotic Sandy never leaves her new-found sister's side.

title: Recall
overview: When a quietly hollowed-out office worker encounters a strange new colleague who seems to know him better than he knows himself, he doesn't realise that every friendly exchange is costing him a piece of who he actually is until there's nothing left to notice.

title: The Odyssey: The Making of an Epic
overview: Go behind the scenes of Christopher Nolan's mythic action epic, The Odyssey. This special documentary explores the monumental undertaking of adapting Homer’s foundational saga for the big screen, charting a grueling 91-day principal photography schedule across six countries. From the revolutionary use of brand-new IMAX film technology to the massive coordination of over 5,300 custom-designed costumes, discover how a star-studded cast led by Matt Damon, Tom Holland, and Anne Hathaway brought the dangerous, timeless world of ancient Greek gods and monsters to life.

title: Bagong tukso 2
overview: Meet the newest faces setting VMX on fire. Angel Castro, Shalanie De Vera, Shannon Sizon, Kim Yashii, and Akira Takamura turn up the heat in this all-new VMX Special. Get to know the women everyone's talking about and discover what makes them the newest VMX craze.

title: COULDN'T AFFORD A JOINT SO I PRETEND
overview: I couldn't afford to buy marijuana. Then I pretend to smoke any.

title: Find Me, Okay?
overview: Saturday morning, Eden Yerushalmi and her best friend, Arbel, are dancing at the Nova Festival. Hours later, Eden is taken to Gaza while her sisters listen helplessly on the phone. What begins as a desperate hope for her return, becomes a journey through uncertainty, public struggle, and devastating loss. Through intimate access to Eden’s mother, sisters, and her best friend Arbel, Find Me, Okay?, follows the fight to bring Eden Yerushalmi home, the moment hope collapses, and the painful attempt to rebuild life afterward. A two-year portrait of love, grief, resilience, and the impossible task of moving forward after trauma.

title: Throwback
overview: A woman reflects on her past while coming to terms with her life through the reflection of her younger self.

title: Go On, Have Another One
overview: David is tormented by Ciggi as he is pressured into smoking

title: Hope
overview: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

title: Comète
overview: As a comet streaks across the Paris sky, lives intersect in a mysterious dance. Two friends roam the city, taking stock of their lives. A young woman reconnects with a father she had long since given up on. Another sells drugs for her brother. Elsewhere, two souls haunted by death cross paths. Meanwhile, actors rehearse a play that strangely mirrors these lives. A portrait of unexpected encounters and the chance events that weave the fabric of our lives.

title: Toronto Apartment
overview: After being dumped, a Toronto man subleases his apartment for an hour or two at a time to make rent as a 'community space.'

title: Snake Eyes
overview: Plagued by premonitions of a dark future, Kasten sets off to hunt down Zangena the wicked - sister to his old nemesis Zolga. However what the warrior isn't aware of is the manipulation of another slippery sorceress. An ancient evil from beyond the Dreamlands is tightening it's coils around his desires.

title: Solitary Dialogues
overview: Torn between confessing his love to Van and the fear of ruining their friendship, Aren drifts through the Parisian night. An encounter with Théo, a former lover, rekindles buried emotions and compels him to redefine the true meaning of love.

title: Generations: The Evolution of Spider-Man
overview: Swing through twenty years of Spider-Man history—from Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield to Tom Holland. Explore the evolution of the iconic suits and stunts, follow Tom's journey into the mask, and get an exclusive look at Peter Parker's next chapter with Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton.

title: A Quiet Blue
overview: Haunted by post-war trauma, 19-year-old Albert confronts his panic attacks through VR therapy to overcome his fears. Aimlessly wandering with friends through a desolate post-industrial city slowly turns an ordinary day into something he could never anticipate.

title: Kafka
overview: A young man named Grigor Grigoryan wakes up from a strange slumber and finds that he has transformed into the writer Franz Kafka. He is shocked by profound sorrow and frailty and he desperately feels the need to understand how he must continue living now.

title: The Dreamed Adventure
overview: The story of a woman living in the border region between Bulgaria, Greece and Turkey, who agrees to partake in a special deal in order to help a friend. However, this will lead her into a dangerous situation, and she will have to confront her desires

title: Ten More Times
overview: A factory worker martyred on July 15 wants to return to Earth to feel that unique spiritual bliss again. He fights relentlessly to be the target of a few more bullets before the sun rises.

title: Descendants: Wicked Wonderland
overview: Now that the Queen of Hearts is nice and Cinderella is safe, things seem perfect for Red and Chloe… But little do they know that changing the past created a new villain — Maddox Hatter. When Maddox captures the Queen of Hearts, Red and Chloe must work alongside Red’s new sister Pink, Luisa Madrigal’s son Luis, and Maddox’s son Max to save her and Wonderland.

title: Take a Piece of Me With You for the Rest of Your Life
overview: Cornélia is on her way to meet her wife, Carmem, at a restaurant that holds special memories for both of them. As the meeting unfolds, small cracks appear in their conversation and silences, revealing hidden layers of their relationship and leaving the impression that not everything is quite as it seems.

title: Cek Khodam
overview: Nowadays, people are more afraid of empty wallets, late payments, and the end of the month than ghosts. Ghosts are even used as entertainment through the content Cek Khodam (Hodgkin's Check) created by three friends, Sakti, Wira, and Bima. Unbeknownst to them, their actions have drastically reduced the Human Fear Score (AKM). To restore the dignity of the supernatural world and raise the human fear score, the Commander of the Khodam is tasked with descending directly into the human world. However, the mission does not go according to plan. The harder the khodam try to scare humans, the more chaos they create.

title: No Name, No Address
overview: Sérgio is a charismatic radio host who presents the show "The Sound of Love", where he reads letters from people seeking help with their relationships and offers them advice. However, when a letter with no return address arrives at the show, Sérgio begins to spiral into a frenzy of guilt and sorrow.

title: Wrecked
overview: Driven by her ambition to win a scholarship to study abroad, a college student leads her close-knit group of friends into an abandoned junkyard to film the season finale of their ghost-hunting channel, hoping to create a viral sensation. But what begins as a quest for views soon turns into a deadly nightmare.

title: Was haben wir gelacht
overview: An entire generation of Germans was raised on male comedians. But what about their female counterparts? Maren Kroymann, Hella von Sinnen, Bettina Böttinger, Esther Schweins, and Gaby Köster look back at the way women were portrayed on TV in the 1990s and early 2000s, when jokes at women’s expense were the order of the day.

title: The Woman with Three Husbands
overview: Concerned her impressionable brother has joined an isolated polyamorous family, Natalie investigates her new 'in-laws'. The strange death of one of Marcus's fellow 'brother husbands' leads Natalie to realize her brother is living with a killer

title: Takkan Kubiarkan Kau Menangis
overview: Dika felt like he was never enough for his mother, Dini, and their relationship was full of conflict. While pursuing his dreams with Sans Band and receiving guidance from Om Radit, Dika finally realized that beneath all his mother's demands lay genuine love and support.

title: Let the Women Wait!
overview: In the course of the summer three brothers-in-law at a crucial age become involved in ephemeral romantic adventures in the area of Lake Volvi while their families vacation on the island of Thassos and… can wait.

title: The Last Footage
overview: When a young boy disappears during a getaway to a remote forest cabin, a desperate blood ritual resurrects a witch’s dead son while a reckless dark web summoning awakens an ancient predator lurking in the wilderness. Trapped between two awakened horrors, a group of friends fight to survive as their final moments are captured through a single pair of camera glasses.  World Premiere at Fantasia International Film Festival 2026.  Written and Directed by Arkar Soe Oo

title: Only Beautiful Things to Look At
overview: Ingrid works as a gynecologist in a district hospital in Slovakia in the late 1980s. Her marriage is at a standstill, she has an affair with a younger colleague in the hospital, and after work, she sits on the abortion committee where they offer Roma women sterilization after the abortion is approved. Eighteen-year-old Agáta, who grew up in a children’s home, comes to work as a nurse at the hospital. Ingrid unexpectedly becomes close to her.

title: Insects – Hidden Heroes
overview: How did our world come into being? Beneath our feet lies a class of animals far more numerous than any other. Let us embark on a journey through time dating back 400 million years, and witness how scattered pieces fit together to form a complete whole. Insects – Hidden Heroes takes us into the microcosm with stunning visuals. Narrated by screen icon Katharina Thalbach, the film poses a question: Must it be humanity or nature?

title: Quando Tudo Joga Contra
overview: On the verge of failing literature, a high school soccer defender begins tutoring sessions with the quiet boy in his class—unaware that their connection will turn into something more.

title: The Odyssey
overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

title: Heartstopper Forever
overview: It's a new school year for the Truham-Higgs gang. As Nick and Charlie's relationship deepens, their thoughts turn to life after the last bell rings.

title: Borderline
overview: Convinced they are our secret saviors, rogue U.S. operatives abduct Mexican gang members and seed them across major American cities, unleashing criminal chaos, swaying voters by playing on nativist prejudices, and forcing law enforcement into a race to expose the plot as the escalating carnage threatens democracy itself.

title: Dastaar
overview: A Sikh immigrant rises from newcomer to community leader following a devastating racist attack.

title: Kill Trip
overview: On the way to a Texas music festival, a group of friends catches a ride with a magnetic van driver. But when people start vanishing, the real headliner becomes survival.

title: A Part of Me
overview: A Friendship crossing twenty years.

title: The Odyssemen
overview: After undergoing the split of Meiosis, meiosisters Orchis and Semes awaken as sperm in the ethereal land of Test, where the annual Testy Festy welcomes them to what seems like heaven. Things take a turn when Seed, a strange sperm donning a condom mask, claims that their paradise is a lie and calls for the start of the Great Jac, a taboo event prophesied to lead either to the Promised Unknown or to death. A sperm civil war breaks out as rebels and loyalists fight over whether their world is truly heaven or merely the prelude to something far greater...

title: Lunok
overview: Astrid Lee and Allison Ross sizzle on screen as they play “dare two friends”, a sexual game that eventually reveals the true feelings they have been hiding from each other. Will they ruin their friendship and give in to their desires?

title: Shark Frenzy
overview: A family vacation goes wrong when their daughter and her friends get lost at sea on a fishing boat. When that boat is destroyed, they survive in a row boat, then the open ocean. Her parents race to find her as sharks circle ever closer in a deadly fight for survival.

title: Ngày Xửa Ngày Xưa 36: Hậu duệ Thần Mặt trời
The Mole Must Die
overview: In the late Chongzhen reign, Heyang County was flooded with corrupt officials, when the Imperial Guards suddenly descended to conduct a thorough crackdown. Spies from rival factions infiltrated the county and vied against one another, and the unspoken catchphrase among all was "All spies must die." Zhao Renbao, a minor local clerk, realizes every powerful figure intends to use him as a pawn. Determined to take control of his fate, he devises an elaborate trap within a trap of his own, outwitting corrupt nobles and officials amid the razor-thin line between life and death.

title: Gauthali
overview: Gauthali, a child bride overcomes abuse, loss, and discrimination through the power of education. Her determination to reclaim her future challenges deep-rooted traditions inspiring to stand against gender inequality.

title: Beyond the Mast
overview: On a fuel-supplying oil tanker in rivers, Old Maqbool, a compassionate cook, wishes luck to all the crew. But the power-hungry helmsman suspects him of being a spy for the vessel owner and harasses him all the time. During port maintenance, Maqbool befriends Noora, a young stowaway seeking refuge. The helmsman exploits the downtime to smuggle oil, which attracts the owner's attention. During a sudden visit, impressed with Maqbool's cooking, the owner allows Noora to stay as his assistant. Desperate to hide his deeds, the helmsman falsely accuses Noora of theft, sparking a web of lies and friction among the crew.

title: A Shadow in the Corner of the Room
overview: Down-on-her-luck nurse, Avery, dismisses a care home resident's warnings of a shadowy presence as dementia...until it begins to turn its attention to her.

title: In the Company of Wolves: An American Journey
overview: Follows the journey of wolves and other animals as co-travelers through American history.

title: Drop Your Cat
overview: An elderly mother in her twilight years grows weary of her identity as a mother. She crosses paths with a troubled young man, and is also haunted by the ghost of her late husband. This sets off a wandering journey across Beijing, under the pretext of abandoning her cat. She lingers like a specter, awkwardly observing and faintly stepping into the distant, disconnected lives of her son, daughter-in-law and friends. Unforeseen incidents arise, their lives collide and intertwine, and amid this constant movement, she rediscovers the vital force of her true self.

title: Arjunan Per Paththu
overview: Arjunan, who witnessed his parents being killed by lightning in front of his eyes, cannot bear the shock and arrives in Chennai from his hometown Madurai. Arjunan, who joined a kayalang shop in Chennai, starts to love a woman. Before marrying that woman, he was a worker and wanted to become an entrepreneur. He gave away all the money he had saved up until then and bought an old Tata Ace and married the woman he loved. Arjuna happily starts driving the vehicle, thinking that his life has become as happy as he thought it would be. Arjuna, who has been facing constant problems with that old vehicle, realizes that he has been completely cheated in buying the vehicle. He brings together all those who have been affected like him and exposes all the frauds in buying and selling old vehicles, seeking justice for himself and all those who have been cheated like him.

title: Horsegirls
overview: As her mother battles an uncertain diagnosis, neurodivergent 22-year-old Margarita discovers a source of strength in an unexpected place: the sport of hobbyhorsing.

title: Water Park Shark
overview: Sharks breach a seaside water park during the debut of a new ride, forcing a lifeguard and the town’s police chief to contain the chaos and protect guests from becoming prey.

title: BAGA : Tomorrow Belongs to No One
overview: Set in a conservative seaside village on Malaysia’s East Coast, BAGA follows Jani and Melur, two young lovers trapped between inherited realities and dreams of escape. When an unexpected pregnancy forces them into a difficult choice, Jani turns to the drug trade in a desperate attempt to secure their future. As love collides with addiction, poverty, and tradition, the couple must confront the cost of survival in a community where opportunities are scarce and every choice carries consequences.

title: Rave
overview: A masked DJ slices and dices his way through an afterparty in the Hollywood Hills.

title: Saturday Night's Main Event XLV
overview: Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk joins forces with Cody Rhodes against Gunther and Sami Zayn, Danhausen competes in his first match at Madison Square Garden as he takes on JD McDonagh in a No Disqualification Match, and WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Paige and Brie Bella defend their title against Lainey Reid and Fallon Henley of Fatal Influence.

title: HER SECOND ACT
overview: Sandra, a middle-aged mother, has long devoted herself to her family, quietly setting aside parts of herself that once felt alive. When she inherits her late brother's bicycle, an impulsive ride leads to an unexpected victory. This sudden recognition begins to unsettle the stillness of her carefully ordered life. As attention grows, the delicate balance within her marriage begins to shift. Long-suppressed dreams, disappointments, and silences between Sandra and her husband rise to the surface, unsettling the roles they have long taken for granted. Caught between the family and the pull of desire, Sandra is drawn into a disorienting second act, where change arrives uninvited, bringing both possibility and consequence for both husband, wife and family.

title: Snowbound for the Holidays
overview: Hotel manager Cassidy Evergreen evaluates a cozy ski lodge, but Christmas magic—and its charming owner, Trey Sanderson—turn a simple assignment into a heartfelt choice between duty and love.

title: 20001 An Earth Odyssey
overview: In the year 20001, three aliens arrive on the ruins of Earth to investigate the extinct human race. Revering humanity as a highly intelligent civilization, they wildly misinterpret the artifacts left behind: mistaking playgrounds for sacred places, umbrellas for communication devices, and graveyards for farmland.  The team consists of a warm-hearted yet misguided captain, a highly logical but often inaccurate analyst, and their innocent, instinctive young member. While the two adults obsessively analyze human civilization through logic and theory, the  youngest slowly begins to understand humanity through emotion, contradiction, and empathy, discovering that what science cannot decode, the heart just might.

title: Terra-Mãe
overview: In a secluded female sanctuary, two expectant mothers prepare to welcome new life under the guidance of an ancient sisterhood. As sacred rituals blur the boundaries between love, motherhood, and sacrifice, they are forced to confront the fragile balance between creation and loss.

title: Crowning at the Prom
overview: On the brink of prom queen glory and a coveted athletic scholarship, obsessive overachiever Kat Walker is determined to maintain the flawless image she's built for herself and for her devoted single mother, Abigail.

overview: Three girls who have known each other for ages are about to shoot a film. Zheng Yuan refuses to weaponize the expressions she holds dearest to her heart; Fang Chi’s tender heart may become a stumbling block on her path as an actress; meanwhile, Zhao Xin, a rookie producer, strives to safeguard their idealism amid this overwhelming chaos.When they return home exhausted, the three discover that their two kittens have vanished without a trace…

title: Big Break
overview: Years after Simple Town split up, three comics reunite with their successful ex-collaborator, leading to a fight for their lives (and careers) as dark secrets are revealed, and these washed-up comedians learn what it really means to kill!

title: The Eater
overview: Douglas' profoundly normal life is thrown into chaos when something starts rearranging his furniture.

title: Attack on Paradise
overview: After seven years in prison, Suleyman is released and determined to pick up his life again. During his incarceration, his home, the flat block ‘Paradise’, has been taken over by gangs and drug dealers. When the police decide to raid Paradise, Suleyman gets caught in the violence, with only one goal: to get back to his mother and get her to safety. Alongside rookie police officer Yasmine, Suleyman battles his way up, floor by floor.

title: Auditoria
overview: In an audition room, Zephyr and June reunite with their past flickering behind. Exchanging dozens of faces and double the glances, they seek to find something to grip within each other. Something that will help to convince, to persuade, to plead. One's truth over the other's.

title: Women Calling
overview: Morgane wakes up after a sexual assault to the sound of a female voice whispering her name. She tries to seek help and make her way home, but strange occurrences appear on her path. Apparitions of women clothed in identical red sheets, incomprehensible phone calls, and hands reaching out toward her disrupt her journey. Morgane loses control of her body and consciousness, forced to relive the night that sealed her fate. She becomes trapped in a nightmare from which she cannot escape. Her only way out might require for blood to be bled.

title: Amityville Alone
overview: Meet Ricky, an 8 year old boy neglected by his father. When Santa forgets to put his presents under the tree, Ricky gets granted three Christmas miracles by the Tree Witch. He wishes to be BIG, he wishes to be HOME ALONE, and finally, he wishes for his E.T.special friend Tito to go from being a dog to a full speaking humanoid. But once Ricky gets in trouble with a local gangster, he and Tito will have to fight for their right... to party!

title: Splash City
overview: Two brothers on diverging paths struggle to survive amidst the pressures of their community.

title: Ends Meat
overview: A woman is confronted with the realization that she's misunderstood the meaning of a common phrase.

title: FESTER
overview: Unable to digest the end of his relationship, Robert develops a haunting gut-rot that sends him spiraling down the toilet... and into his ex-girlfriend's new lover's apartment.
